Author: The Kinship
Name: Rafter Cat's Spot Light
Punchline: Mark the items you need to keep, and they stand out in your inventory.
Description:
Right-click any item and choose "Spot Light: mark as important", or search for items in the Spot Light window (/spotlight). Important items get a bold, easy-to-see highlight so you know not to sell or throw them away.

It only reads your inventory to know where to draw. It never moves, sells or uses anything.
Changelog: 0.1.0: First version: your important items list. Right-click any item in your bags and choose "Spot Light: mark as important" (or "not important any more"). /spotlight opens a window with your list and a search to add any game item. The highlight in your inventory comes in the next piece.
